name: Paths Taken
source:
Emory is an 18 year old noble of Sharan, a wealthy kingdom made even wealthier by Emory's father, an entrepreneur and prolific business man who's been the king's aid for all things finance for years. As such, Emory is best friends with the king's only child, Cordelian, a 19 year old boy who's being prepped to take over the kingdom. Along with Cordelian, Emory spends their days with Lisia, their personal maid, and Marco, Cordelian's butler. However, Emory's daily, carefree life gets a small wrench in it when he finally meets the princess of a neighboring, rival country, and finds out that Cordelian and her are engaged...
​
[From [url=http://mikomikisomi.weebly.com/paths-taken] Mikomi Game's Website[/url]]
translation:
埃默里是沙兰王国18岁的贵族。这个富裕的王国因埃默里的父亲而更加富有，他是一名企业家和成功商人，多年来一直担任国王的财政顾问。因此，埃默里与国王唯一的孩子、正准备接管王国的19岁少年科德利安是最好的朋友。

埃默里每天与科德利安的贴身女仆莉西亚和科德利安的管家马可一起度过，生活无忧无虑。然而，当他终于见到邻国那个敌对国家的公主，并得知科德利安与她已经订婚时，他平静的日常被撬开了一道缝隙……

（来源：[url=http://mikomikisomi.weebly.com/paths-taken]Mikomi Game网站[/url]）
